items.t: Sales Orders — Added new status filters and a Type column to the Sales Order list.
Purchase Orders — Added new status filters and a Type column to the Purchase Order list.
Dropdown — Fixed dropdowns showing "-1" instead of blank after Clear Screen For New Entry.
Runtime — Fixed a control's disabled state set during screen load being overwritten by its designed state.
App Builder — Fixed Undo not reverting a screen background color change.
App Builder — Fixed the Table picker saving the previous dropdown's table instead of the newly selected one.
Container — Fixed the screen background color not showing behind containers on mobile.
Container — Fixed flex containers showing internal scrollbars even when their height was fixed.
App Builder — Removed the 40-row height cap on Tabs components.
Container — Fixed insufficient spacing between a bordered flex container's border and its components.
Container — Fixed uneven padding around a bordered grid container's contents.
Address Lookup — Fixed the Address lookup suggestion list being clipped inside a container.
App Builder — Added Storybook test coverage for the V4 radio button components.
Dropdown — Fixed changing a dropdown's Display value from adding the old field as a subtitle.
App Builder — Fixed missing spacing below a horizontal radio group on the Add Field screen.
App Builder — Fixed the Attachments component rendering with extra empty space.
Label — Fixed date and time labels not following the account's Display settings format.
Chart — Fixed the chart drilldown focus shadow misaligning with the canvas.
Label — Fixed a Label's icon being misaligned with its text.
App Builder — Fixed copying a screen opening the legacy Designer instead of App Builder.
Runtime Customization — Polished the visual design of the Customize pill and menu.
App Builder — Added auto-scrolling in App Builder when dragging components near the canvas edge.
Tables & Fields — Fixed new tables and fields being incorrectly labeled as custom source in TemplateDevV2.
App Builder — Restored component selection after undo and redo in App Builder.
Method AI — Added the ability to create dropdown fields bound to existing tables via Method AI.
App Builder — Fixed control selection not working while a dropdown's options list was open.
Signature — Fixed missing required-field indicators on Signature components.
Runtime — Reduced the delay before dynamic-height components grow at runtime.
App Builder —
App Builder — Fixed editable input fields allowing selection of read-only Linked fields as a mapping target.
Grids — Fixed hiding an Editable Grid's default view from breaking the screen at runtime.
Grids — Prevented all columns from being hidden in an Editable Grid.
Billing — Extended partner and account discount handling to the new SKU billing plans.
User Management — Added routing to a new SKU-aware Users page behind a rollout flag.
User Management — Renamed an internal user-role database column to avoid colliding with customer-created fields.
Multi-entity — Fixed an issue where the Multi-entity Management link sometimes didn't appear in Account Settings due to incorrect enablement.
Account API — Secured account state and configuration endpoints against unauthorized cross-account access.
User Management API — Added role and seat metadata to internal user-list and user-detail API contracts.
Method Pay — Fixed a webhook check that blocked saving a tokenized card for an account whose name didn't match its account ID.
Method Pay — Reset an account's Method Pay connection cleanly after a cancellation.
Method Pay — Suppressed the rejection email and internal alert for Method Pay cancellations.
Activities — Fixed an issue where My Activities preferences were disabled for users without Activities manage permission.
Actions — Added Character Functions to validate and format phone numbers for SMS.
Requirements Tooling — Fixed internal requirement records so they sync correctly to the requirements hub.
Email Screening — Masked card numbers and other sensitive data in the internal held-email review screen.
App Builder — Added a feature-flag gate controlling when the Kanban board component can be placed.
Kanban Board — Reworked the Kanban board control to match its intended design and render live data.
Editable Grid — Redesigned and improved Card Column configuration experience.
